items.headline: Bitquery Flags 400 BTC Gap in $SYRUP Backing
items.summary: Bitquery found Maple's listed wallets hold ~97.6% of the BTC reported for syrupUSDC, a 400 BTC shortfall, though counted collateral still exceeds loans.

items.headline: $SOON Unlocks 20.24M Tokens Worth $5.3M Today
items.summary: $SOON unlocked roughly 20.24 million tokens (~$5.3M) on Nov 23, a fresh supply event traders are watching for price impact.

items.headline: Whale With 15% Win Rate Up $9.7M on $HYPE DEX
items.summary: A Hyperliquid whale with just a 15.1% win rate sits on $18.95M in profitable leveraged longs across ETH, BTC and NVDA, with $9.7M cumulative profit.

items.headline: $ARB Q3 Revenue Jumps 200% to $7.4M
items.summary: Arbitrum Foundation reported Q3 treasury revenue of $7.4M, up 200% QoQ, with Robinhood Chain contributing $5M+ in licensing fees and RWA AUM near $1.1B.

items.headline: $CYBER Bridge Mints 5.21M Tokens Out of Nowhere
items.summary: $CYBER's bridge minted 5.21 million tokens while its Ethereum vault released the same amount just 107 seconds later, echoing the ongoing exploit saga.
